The orcish factory is a large (10x5) workshop that allows for bulk manufacture. All reactions require fuel. In particular, it allows:

== Production of construction materials ==

The factory provides an efficient way to produce construction materials.

* Creating bricks (40) from clay (5). Coloured bricks require 2 units of a dye-producing plant.
* Creating rebar (40) from stone (3) and rusty iron (3). Rebar can be used in constructions and buildings{{verify}}.
* Creating cinderblock (20) from ash (3).

== Production of charcoal ==

* Farmed tree (1) to charcoal (1)
* Farmed fungitree (1) to charcoal (1)
* Farmed irontree (1) to charcoal (2)
* Farmed steeltree (1) to charcoal (4)

== Creation of bulk weapons/armor ==

Many reactions are available, using copper, rusty iron, silver, bronze, and steel. Material efficiency on these reactions tends to be high. Products include:

* Barbed wire
* Daggers
* Mauls
* Spears
* Chain-whips
* Scimitars
* Axes
* Clubs
* Bucklers
* Kite Shields
* Mail
* Breastplates
